description:
Configure the 'My Portfolio' view in JStock to hide sensitive financial values for a client presentation. 

Goal: Customize the portfolio table columns to HIDE all absolute currency amounts (Purchase Price, Current Price, Purchase Value, Current Value, Net Purchase Value, Gain/Loss Value, etc.) while KEEPING the 'Units', 'Date', and percentage return columns ('Gain/Loss %' or 'Net Gain/Loss %') visible. 

Instructions:
1. Open the 'My Portfolio' tab (data is already loaded).
2. Edit the table column visibility (usually via right-click on header or View menu) to uncheck/hide all columns showing dollar amounts.
3. Verify that only the stock codes, dates, units, and percentages remain visible.
4. Take a screenshot of this anonymized view and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/anonymized_portfolio.png'.
